blurb: Guests rent pontoon, speed, fishing boats, kayaks, canoes, paddleboards, and tubes to enjoy Douglas Lake. Rentals include gas, taxes, and a free ice cream per person. The marina operates daily from April 1 to September 2, with boats returning by 8 PM.
extraNote: Full payment required upfront, no deposits · Cancellation 7+ days in advance: full refund or gift certificate valid 1 year · Cancellation 2-7 days in advance: no refund, gift certificate valid 1 year · Cancellation less than 48 hours: no refund or gift certificate · Rain check if unsafe conditions while on water and return to marina; gift certificate valid 1 year · Late return fee $50 per 15 minutes · Douglas Lake Marina Rental office at 1170 Highway 139, Dandridge, Tennessee 37725 · April 1 to September 2
